name: Ku
desc: Ku, known as the "Mother" in Capran tradition, represents the shared knowledge of mankind. Ku is described as both student and teacher, stating, “Ku is of us, and we are of Ku. Always both mother and child, student and teacher.” reflecting the Capran ideal of lifelong learning. It seems that she is a nurturing figure, judging by the Mark of Ku ability granted by the Ku variant of Capra.
